caption: Each column is one recorded candidate for the target diphone /a-t/ (target 180 Hz, 90 ms); each row is one cost term. Candidate 1 wins because its terms add to 0.30, against 0.66 for candidate 2.

spec.title: /a-t/ target: 180 Hz, 90 ms
spec.aria: A two-column cost table for the diphone /a-t/ with target 180 Hz and 90 ms: candidate 1 has F0 term 0.06, duration term 0.04 and join cost 0.20 for a total of 0.30; candidate 2 has 0.12, 0.04 and 0.50 for a total of 0.66, so candidate 1 is chosen.
